title: Room darkening curtains. Great buy!
text:
Room darkening curtains. Great buy!. I love these! They literally block most of the daylight that streams into my living room and somewhat help keeping the dogs from barking at the leaves that flutter by. 😂 My only issue is the dogs have learned how to move the one side making me want to nail the entire side of the curtain to the wall. 😂

Recommendation get a rounded curtain rod so the curtains curve around to really block all the light. Great investment with 5 large dogs that were always barking when I had lighter colored curtains.

These are not intended to be sheer whatsoever so not sure why they asked about sheerness with the stars.

If you want a dark room these are a great purchase.
